route.description: prerequisites: an actual Task builds a consumed output this Task waits for. missing-work: no actual Task builds a consumed output. repository: the failure comes from the Task repository's own declarations or configuration (a dependency manifest, lock file, overrides, a peer-dependency conflict, a test or build configuration naming a package no manifest declares), which the build corrects in its worktree. environment: a cause outside the repository (a missing tool or runtime, credentials, network or service availability).

authoringStory.description: Only an actual existing open Story whose completed saved scope/spec authorizes missing producer work; null when none can be established.
